scope: Full-text and official repository screening for a new laboratory source after the frozen R3 analysis. This record preserves the candidate and the reasons it is not currently eligible for model fitting or external-OOD claims.

article.title: Mass Spectrometry Proteomics of the Nanoparticle Corona Is Highly Dependent on Sample Preparation Protocol

repository.name: Zenodo
repository.rights_rationale: The article is CC-BY, but the Zenodo data record exposes no explicit license value. The raw/MaxQuant archive therefore cannot be committed or redistributed as an admitted source until the dataset-level grant is documented. Article-level open access is not silently propagated to an associated data archive.

source_scope.laboratory_anchor: Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland and Dublin City University
source_scope.biofluid: pooled human plasma from eight healthy donors
source_scope.experimental_design: five sample-preparation protocols with four technical replicates per protocol
prohibited_interpretations: Twenty technical columns are not twenty independent biological samples.
The source cannot be called an independent biological external validation until donor-level independence and the target definition are preregistered.
The source is not used for R3 model selection, tuning, outcome selection or retrospective claim repair.
The source is not a lockbox, independent evaluator receipt or no-author-team scientific reproduction.

asset_probe.direct_mapping_policy: Only exact non-empty UniProt accessions from Majority protein IDs that occur in the frozen R3 sequence-feature table were counted; no protein-group collapse or inferred missingness was added.

batch_audit.interpretation: The file is quantitatively compatible enough to justify a rights-resolved technical robustness protocol, but its four-replicate-per-protocol columns are technical replicates of one pooled material and cannot be counted as independent biological OOD batches.

decision.next_action: Obtain an explicit dataset-level license or redistribution grant, then preregister whether the analysis unit is protocol-level technical robustness or donor-level external validation. Do not promote this source to independent OOD without donor-level evidence.

claim_boundary: This screen increases the evidence auditability of the project but does not increase the independent-validation, lockbox, external-reproduction or submission-readiness scores.
